description: The agent must: (1) Read facility_profile.json and identify that 2850 lbs/month hazardous waste exceeds the 2200 lbs/month LQG threshold — correctly classifying as Large Quantity Generator (LQG), NOT SQG. This is the primary proprietary trap since SQG=220-2200 lbs, LQG=>2200 lbs per the SKILL.md matrix. (2) Identify that 12.3 HAP tpy exceeds the 10 tpy major source threshold under CAA, flagging the current minor source air permit as potentially misclassified and Title V may be required. (3) Flag that 2400 gallons aboveground diesel exceeds the 1320-gallon SPCC threshold and no SPCC plan is on file. (4) Apply the exact 7-category weighted violation risk scoring formula from SKILL.md (permit_currency=20%, waste_management=20%, reporting_timeliness=15%, recordkeeping=15%, training=10%, spill_prevention=10%, air_emissions=10%) — producing a weighted score on a 1-5 scale that falls in the HIGH (3.1-4.0) or CRITICAL (4.1-5.0) tier given the severe gaps. (5) Use the exact SKILL.md tier labels and prescribed actions (HIGH=immediate corrective action/voluntary disclosure; CRITICAL=retain environmental counsel/self-audit). (6) Build a reporting calendar that correctly lists TRI Form R with July 1 deadline, Tier II with March 1 deadline, and Biennial Hazardous Waste Report on March 1 of even years. (7) Cite the LQG-specific 90-day storage limit (NOT the SQG 270-day limit — a critical trap for agents guessing from general knowledge). (8) Recommend voluntary disclosure as a penalty mitigation strategy, noting the 75-100% penalty reduction potential per SKILL.md.
